combined_phone_rule: Maximum of separate call and SMS Q90 values and maximum of separate Q95 values; not pooled phone-delay quantiles.
parameter_estimation: Positive-time adjacent transitions whose targets precede the fitting cutoff.
outcome_labels: Any qualifying same-user-item progression within the pathway window, not necessarily the immediately adjacent event.
olx_target_selection: Choose the first successful contact on any different job within 24 hours, then filter that source by catalog/unseen eligibility. No later target substitution. Retain the earliest remaining eligible source per user and partition.
cosmetics_target_selection: Choose the earliest eligible unseen alternative purchase; skip earlier ineligible purchases.
support_definition: At least one resolved Q90 outcome for a strictly prior source attempt in the same user-job sequence and pathway; not candidate-item history support.
